description: ARRAY_INSERT(array, pos, element) - a 0-based insert that shifts later elements right, appends when pos equals the array size, counts from the end for a negative pos (-1 inserts before the last element), and answers NULL for a NULL array. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayInsertTest (now retired); the array cells are read through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell.
